name: control-room
description: A big-button control panel for driving Claude Code from inside the editor.

commands.title: Control Room: Open every control room in this workspace
Control Room: Resume a Claude session in a terminal
Control Room: Install the session-start watch hook

controlRoom.logPath.description: Where chat.jsonl lives. Empty means every control-room* folder in the workspace is offered as a separate panel; setting it pins the extension to one log.

controlRoom.openOnStartup.description: Open the Control Room panel when the workspace opens. Only when the workspace holds exactly one control room; otherwise use the palette so nothing is guessed.

controlRoom.mirrorEditorChat.description: Copy the Claude tab's conversation into the panel, so it holds both sides rather than only what was typed in it. Mirrored lines are marked and are never answered a second time.
